headline: Approved changes to pension plan investment fund lineup and a portfolio rebalance to target allocation.
summary: The commission reviewed the Town's 457 plan and pension plan performance for the quarter ending June 30, 2026, with reports from Fiducient Advisors and Sageview. It voted to adjust several investment funds on its watch list and lineup, and to rebalance the portfolio to target allocation.
decisions: Placed MFS Growth R6 and JPMorgan Mid Cap Value R6 on the Quantitative Watch List, approved unanimously.
Replaced Wasatch Core Growth Institutional with MassMutual Small Cap Gr Eq1, approved unanimously.
Kept Victory Sycamore Small Company Opp R6 on the Quantitative Watch List after discussion.
Replaced Conestoga Small Cap Institutional with Drieshaus Small Cap Growth Institutional, approved unanimously.
Approved rebalancing the portfolio to target allocation, unanimously.
